pages.title: Sustainability
pages.body_html:
Our Sustainability Promise

At ÉLAN, we believe that luxury and sustainability are not mutually exclusive. Every decision we make—from material sourcing to production methods—is guided by our commitment to reducing our environmental impact.

Sustainable Materials

We prioritize organic, recycled, and responsibly sourced materials:

  • Organic Cotton - GOTS certified, grown without harmful pesticides
  • Recycled Fabrics - Giving new life to existing materials
  • Responsible Wool - Certified by the Responsible Wool Standard
  • Deadstock Fabrics - Reducing waste by using surplus materials

Ethical Production

All our garments are produced in facilities that meet strict ethical standards. We ensure fair wages, safe working conditions, and respect for workers' rights throughout our supply chain.

Packaging & Shipping

Our packaging is 100% recyclable and made from recycled materials. We use biodegradable mailers and minimize plastic wherever possible.

Take Action

Explore our sustainably made collections:

  • Women's Collection
  • Men's Collection
  • New Arrivals

Learn more about our values on our About page, or read our Journal for sustainability tips and insights.

pages.title: Cookie Policy
pages.body_html:
Last updated: December 2024

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and understanding how you use our site.

Types of Cookies We Use

Essential Cookies

These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility. You cannot opt out of these cookies.

Analytics Cookies

We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website. This helps us improve our site's performance and user experience.

Marketing Cookies

These cookies track your browsing habits to deliver personalized advertising. They remember that you've visited our website and share this information with advertisers.

Preference Cookies

These cookies remember your settings and preferences, such as language and region, to provide a more personalized experience.

Managing Cookies

You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Please note that removing or blocking certain cookies may impact your user experience and some features may no longer work correctly.

How to Manage Cookies:

  • Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
  • Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Cookies
  • Firefox: Options > Privacy & Security > Cookies
  • Edge: Settings > Privacy > Cookies

Third-Party Cookies

We use trusted third-party services that may also set cookies. These include:

  • Google Analytics (website analytics)
  • Shopify (e-commerce platform)
  • Social media platforms (if you interact with our social media content)

Your Choices

By using our website, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this policy. You can withdraw your consent at any time by adjusting your browser settings or using our cookie preference tool.

Contact Us

If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us.

For more information about how we protect your data, please read our Privacy Policy.

pages.title: About ÉLAN
pages.body_html:
Our Story

Founded in 2018, ÉLAN was born from a simple yet powerful vision: to create timeless fashion that respects both people and planet. What began as a small atelier in Paris has grown into a global brand known for its unwavering commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and sustainability.

Our Philosophy

We believe in the power of slow fashion—pieces designed to last, transcending seasons and trends. Each ÉLAN garment is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, using responsibly sourced materials and ethical production methods.

Our Values

  • Timeless Design - We create pieces that remain relevant season after season
  • Quality Craftsmanship - Every garment is made to the highest standards
  • Sustainability - We prioritize the planet in every decision we make
  • Transparency - We believe in honest, open communication about our practices
  • Community - We support and celebrate the artisans and communities we work with

Global Presence

From our flagship store in Paris to our locations in London and New York, ÉLAN has become a destination for those who value quality over quantity. Visit our stores to experience the ÉLAN world in person.

Join Our Journey

Explore our commitment to sustainability, read our journal for insights and inspiration, or discover career opportunities to join our team.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.body_html:
How Can We Help?

Find answers to the most common questions about shopping with ÉLAN. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our customer service team.

Orders & Shipping

How long does shipping take?

Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping (2-3 days) and Next Day Delivery are also available. See our full Shipping Policy for details.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes! We ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International delivery times vary by destination (7-21 business days).

Can I track my order?

Absolutely. Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track orders in your account dashboard.

Returns & Exchanges

What is your return policy?

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unworn, unwashed items with original tags attached. Domestic returns are free. See our Return Policy for complete details.

How do I return an item?

Log into your account, go to Order History, select the order, and click "Return Items." Print the prepaid label and drop off at any authorized shipping location.

Do you offer exchanges?

We don't offer direct exchanges. Simply return the unwanted item and place a new order for your desired size or color.

Products & Sizing

How do I find my size?

Each product page includes a detailed size guide. We recommend checking the specific measurements for each item, as sizing can vary by style.

Are your products sustainable?

Yes! We're committed to sustainable fashion. Learn more about our practices on our Sustainability page.

How should I care for my ÉLAN pieces?

Care instructions are included on the label of each garment. Generally, we recommend hand washing or gentle machine wash in cold water, and air drying to extend the life of your pieces.

Account & Payment

Do I need an account to place an order?

No, you can checkout as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to track orders, save addresses, and access your order history.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

Still Have Questions?

Contact us and our team will be happy to help.
